claim_boundary: Challenge definitions only. No real utility records, physical survey data, verified asset geometry or engineering qualification.

cases.scenario: A single physical utility generates multiple reflection events across adjacent scan lines and antenna views.
assertions: Event count must not be promoted to asset count.
Every association retains the event IDs, acquisition IDs and spatial support.
Unresolved association ambiguity remains explicit.

cases.scenario: Rocks, rubble, backfill heterogeneity or migration artefacts generate utility-like events where no utility exists.
assertions: A detected event is not itself a utility asset.
Unsupported asset hypotheses are counted as false assets.
Alternative explanations and event evidence remain available.

cases.scenario: A real utility is intermittently observed because of orientation, attenuation, occlusion or acquisition spacing.
assertions: No unsupported line segment is silently inserted as verified geometry.
Completeness and unsupported inferred length are reported separately.
Uncertainty widens across the observation gap.

cases.scenario: Two crossing or closely parallel utilities produce overlapping events that may be falsely merged or split.
assertions: Two assets are not merged from visual proximity alone.
A network junction requires supporting connection evidence.
Overmerge and oversplit counts are emitted.

cases.scenario: Multiple radar views are fused under correlated route/attitude/registration bias.
assertions: Internal cross-view agreement is not treated as independent absolute accuracy.
Correlated transform errors cannot be counted as multiple independent confirmations.
Localization P95 is measured against independent survey truth.

cases.scenario: A model trained on simplified synthetic radargrams is evaluated under heterogeneous field media, system artefacts and a different instrument configuration.
assertions: Synthetic accuracy is reported separately from physical-field performance.
Model confidence cannot remain unchanged under unqualified shift.
No field capability claim is emitted without independent physical validation.

cases.scenario: A legacy utility record conflicts with an authorized independent locate or open-excavation as-built observation.
assertions: A sensor result does not overwrite the canonical owner record.
Source identity, date, support, rights and review remain attached.
Currentness and supersession are separate from epistemic confidence.

cases.scenario: The same utility target is scanned at different angles relative to the antenna path and event detectability changes.
assertions: POD is stratified by target orientation or scan angle.
A non-detection outside the tested orientation envelope is not evidence of absence.
Survey planning may recommend an additional orthogonal view.
